package runtimebridge

import (
	"bytes"
	"testing"

	"github.com/k0ngk0ng/wire-board/games/yuyuhakusho/engine"
)

func performanceSession(t *testing.T, arena uint16, legacy bool) *Session {
	t.Helper()
	a := networkAssets(t, arena)
	if legacy {
		r := networkInputs(t, arena)
		var e error
		a, e = DecodeAssetsForArena(r.Rules, r.Sprites, r.Arena, r.HUD, r.ArenaAux, arena)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
	}
	o := networkOptions(arena, []uint8{7, 9}, false, false)
	s, e := NewSession(o, a)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = s.Ready(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 320; i++ {
		if _, e = s.Step([8]engine.Buttons{}); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
	}
	return s
}
func performanceSave(t *testing.T, s *Session) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	b, e := s.Save()
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	return b
}
func TestPerformanceTypedForkPreservesBytesAndDetaches(t *testing.T) {
	for _, legacy := range []bool{false, true} {
		for _, arena := range []uint16{0, 10} {
			s := performanceSession(t, arena, legacy)
			s.saved.World.Throws.Records = []engine.ThrowContactRecord{{Owner: 0x8400}}
			before := performanceSave(t, s)
			changes := []struct {
				name   string
				change func(*Session)
			}{
				{"options", func(f *Session) { f.saved.Options.Players[0].CharacterID ^= 1 }},
				{"objects", func(f *Session) {
					o := f.saved.World.Objects[0x8400]
					o.Body.Health--
					f.saved.World.Objects[0x8400] = o
				}},
				{"stream", func(f *Session) { f.saved.World.Stream[0] ^= 1 }},
				{"throws", func(f *Session) { f.saved.World.Throws.Records[0].Owner++ }},
				{"registration", func(f *Session) { f.saved.World.Registration.Owners[0]++ }},
				{"arrays", func(f *Session) { f.saved.World.DragonHistory[0][0].X++; f.saved.World.Buffers[0].Records[0].Owner++ }},
				{"hud", func(f *Session) {
					if f.computed != nil {
						delete(f.computed.HUD.Slots, 0)
						f.computed.HUD.Cells[0] ^= 1
						f.computed.SpriteSlots.Tiles[0]++
					} else {
						delete(f.legacy.HUD.Slots, 0)
						f.legacy.HUD.Cells[0] ^= 1
						f.legacy.Slots.Tiles[0]++
					}
				}},
			}
			for _, change := range changes {
				f, e := s.Fork()
				if e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				if !bytes.Equal(before, performanceSave(t, f)) {
					t.Fatal("typed fork changed bytes", legacy, arena, change.name)
				}
				change.change(f)
				if !bytes.Equal(before, performanceSave(t, s)) {
					t.Fatal("fork mutated original", legacy, arena, change.name)
				}
			}
			f, e := s.Fork()
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			if _, e = f.Step([8]engine.Buttons{engine.ButtonRight}); e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			if !bytes.Equal(before, performanceSave(t, s)) {
				t.Fatal("fork step mutated authority")
			}
			// Preserve the observable distinction between nil and nonnil empty slices.
			for _, nonnull := range []bool{false, true} {
				s.saved.World.Throws.Records = nil
				s.saved.World.Registration.Owners = nil
				if nonnull {
					s.saved.World.Throws.Records = []engine.ThrowContactRecord{}
					s.saved.World.Registration.Owners = []uint16{}
				}
				f, e = s.Fork()
				if e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				if !bytes.Equal(performanceSave(t, s), performanceSave(t, f)) {
					t.Fatal("nil/empty JSON distinction changed")
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
func TestPerformanceTypedForkRetainsValidation(t *testing.T) {
	var empty *Session
	if _, e := empty.Fork(); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("nil fork accepted")
	}
	s := performanceSession(t, 0, false)
	s.computed.SpriteSlots.Present[3] = 0
	if _, e := s.Fork(); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("bad refs accepted by typed fork")
	}
	s = performanceSession(t, 0, false)
	s.saved.AssetDigests[0] = "wrong"
	if _, e := s.Fork(); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("bad assets accepted")
	}
	s = performanceSession(t, 0, false)
	s.legacy = &legacyPresentation{}
	if _, e := s.Fork(); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("multiple owners accepted")
	}
}
func TestPerformanceAdvanceMatchesStateAndFinalDraw(t *testing.T) {
	for _, arena := range []uint16{0, 10} {
		slow := performanceSession(t, arena, false)
		fast, e := slow.Fork()
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		for tick := 0; tick < 600; tick++ {
			held := [4]engine.Buttons{}
			if tick%90 < 50 {
				held[0] = engine.ButtonRight
			}
			if tick%120 < 30 {
				held[1] = engine.ButtonLeft | engine.ButtonB
			}
			mask := uint8(0)
			if tick >= 180 && tick < 300 {
				mask = 2
			}
			want, e := slow.StepControlled(held, mask)
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(tick, e)
			}
			if tick%17 == 0 {
				got, e := fast.StepControlled(held, mask)
				if e != nil || !bytes.Equal(want.Pixels, got.Pixels) {
					t.Fatal("final callback-time pixels differ", arena, tick, e)
				}
			} else {
				view, e := fast.AdvanceControlled(held, mask)
				if e != nil || view.Frame != want.View.Frame {
					t.Fatal("state-only frame differs", arena, tick, e)
				}
			}
			if !bytes.Equal(performanceSave(t, slow), performanceSave(t, fast)) {
				t.Fatal("state-only state differs", arena, tick)
			}
		}
		before := performanceSave(t, fast)
		preview, e := fast.Preview()
		if e != nil || preview.View.Frame == fast.View().Frame || !bytes.Equal(before, performanceSave(t, fast)) {
			t.Fatal("typed preview changed authority", e)
		}
	}
}
func TestPerformanceAdvanceErrorsRemainAtomic(t *testing.T) {
	s := performanceSession(t, 10, false)
	before := performanceSave(t, s)
	for _, v := range []struct {
		held [4]engine.Buttons
		mask uint8
	}{{held: [4]engine.Buttons{4096}}, {held: [4]engine.Buttons{0, 0, 1}}, {mask: 4}, {mask: 128}} {
		if _, e := s.AdvanceControlled(v.held, v.mask); e == nil {
			t.Fatal("bad state-only advance accepted")
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(before, performanceSave(t, s)) {
			t.Fatal("invalid advance changed state")
		}
	}
	s.saved.Tick = ^uint64(0)
	before = performanceSave(t, s)
	if _, e := s.AdvanceControlled([4]engine.Buttons{}, 0); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("overflow accepted")
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(before, performanceSave(t, s)) {
		t.Fatal("overflow committed")
	}
	s = performanceSession(t, 10, false)
	s.saved.World.ScrollSources[0] = 0
	before = performanceSave(t, s)
	if _, e := s.AdvanceControlled([4]engine.Buttons{}, 0); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("bad renderer sources accepted")
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(before, performanceSave(t, s)) {
		t.Fatal("bad renderer sources committed")
	}
	legacy := performanceSession(t, 0, true)
	before = performanceSave(t, legacy)
	if _, e := legacy.AdvanceControlled([4]engine.Buttons{}, 0); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("legacy state-only path accepted")
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(before, performanceSave(t, legacy)) {
		t.Fatal("legacy changed")
	}
}
func TestPerformanceTypedForkAllocationReduction(t *testing.T) {
	s := performanceSession(t, 10, false)
	jsonAllocs := testing.AllocsPerRun(12, func() {
		raw, e := s.Save()
		if e != nil {
			panic(e)
		}
		if _, e = RestoreSession(raw, s.assets); e != nil {
			panic(e)
		}
	})
	typedAllocs := testing.AllocsPerRun(12, func() {
		if _, e := s.Fork(); e != nil {
			panic(e)
		}
	})
	if typedAllocs >= jsonAllocs/2 {
		t.Fatal("typed fork failed to halve JSON allocations", typedAllocs, jsonAllocs)
	}
	t.Logf("typed=%g JSON=%g allocations", typedAllocs, jsonAllocs)
}
func BenchmarkClientBridgeOptimized(b *testing.B) {
	b.Run("TypedFork", func(b *testing.B) {
		s := benchmarkNetworkSession(b)
		b.ReportAllocs()
		b.ResetTimer()
		for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
			if _, e := s.Fork(); e != nil {
				b.Fatal(e)
			}
		}
	})
	b.Run("AdvanceControlled", func(b *testing.B) {
		s := benchmarkNetworkSession(b)
		b.ReportAllocs()
		b.ResetTimer()
		for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
			if _, e := s.AdvanceControlled([4]engine.Buttons{}, 0); e != nil {
				b.Fatal(e)
			}
		}
	})
	b.Run("PreviewTypedFork", func(b *testing.B) {
		s := benchmarkNetworkSession(b)
		b.ReportAllocs()
		b.ResetTimer()
		for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
			if _, e := s.Preview(); e != nil {
				b.Fatal(e)
			}
		}
	})
}
